feeds.title: Diabetic Foodie Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Shelby Kinnaird to help people eat healthy, local, diabetic-friendly food that tastes great, diabetic diet.Diabetic Foodie is run by people living with diabetes and all the recipes are created with blood sugar management, as well as our tastebuds, in mind.

feeds.title: Diabetes Dad
feeds.description: Tom Karlya has been known in the diabetes community as Diabetes Dad for years and shares his perspective from a parents point of view. Emotionally mixed stories with truth and humor as well as welcoming other comments from the Diabetes Online Community.

feeds.title: Diabetes Stories
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Riva. I have had type 1 diabetes for 48 years. I got it at 18. The blog began by collecting peoples' 'stories' of living with diabetes including those of loved ones and health professionals. I have gathered more than 175 stories. Today my mission includes helping people craft their 'flourishing story' of living with diabetes.

feeds.title: Diabetogenic Blog
feeds.description: Diabetogenic is a blog about real life with type 1 diabetes. I'm Renza Scibilia and I live in inner-Melbourne, Australia. I've lived with type 1 since 1998 and for the last eighteen years, I've used an insulin pump. These days I'm all about automation and am more than happily Looping. I work for a diabetes organisation.

feeds.title: Hangry Woman
feeds.description: I am Mila Clarke-Buckley, a food writer, author, stigma slayer, and more. Living with diabetes sucks. So let's talk about food, self-care, and diabetes topics that sometimes feel like they're off-limits. This is an open and safe space for you.

feeds.title: Viasox Blog
feeds.description: Viasox Blog is a comprehensive online resource dedicated to empowering individuals with diabetes by providing valuable information, practical tips, and personal stories. Our blog covers a wide range of topics, including diabetes management, foot care, nutrition, exercise, and mental health.

feeds.title: The Savvy Diabetic Blog
feeds.description: I'm Joanne Laufer Milo. I have Type 1 diabetes. The Savvy Diabetic is a blog about Type 1 diabetes. The goal is to share information about new technologies, exciting research, cool and helpful topics about living with T1D, tips on being prepared as a T1D plus stories about T1Ds and their pets!

feeds.title: South Africans with Diabetes
feeds.description: A space for Type 1 and Type 2 diabetics, Sweet Life is a South African diabetic community that offers diabetic advice, tips and expert opinions through a community blog, monthly diabetes newsletter and

feeds.title: Gestational Diabetes UK Blog
feeds.description: Gestational Diabetes UK is dedicated to offering support and evidence based research to women diagnosed with gestational diabetes in the UK and Ireland.

feeds.title: T1D Exchange Magazine
feeds.description: T1D Exchange is dedicated to improving outcomes for the entire Type 1 Diabetes population through driving real-world evidence and collaborative change.

feeds.title: Diabetes Health
feeds.description: Diabetes Health magazine, published by King's Publishing in California, United States, is one of the US's biggest magazines focusing on diabetes and the complications that are the every day concern of people with this disease and also their families and friends.

feeds.title: Diabetic Sock Club Blog
feeds.description: Our diabetic footcare blog has hundreds of article about how to take care of your feet and ensure a more comfortable lifestyle.

feeds.title: Anodyne Blog
feeds.description: Things that a person must do to avoid diabetes - exercise , diet control. Anodyne is a diabetic footwear company bringing an unparalleled collection of therapeutic footwear to the market! Anodyne blog posts cover diabetic foot care tips, diabetic recipes, medicare updates, and more information on diabetic shoes.

feeds.title: Diabetes Care Community
feeds.description: Diabetes Care Community is privileged to have the following Canadian leading health care professionals write blogs for our community. These diabetes experts have been engaged for many years in helping people with diabetes lead healthier lives. Their blogs include ideas and advice for a healthy diet, self-management, medication and monitoring, physical activity and emotional support.

feeds.title: Integrated Diabetes Blog
feeds.description: The worldwide leader in one-on-one consulting for Diabetes, Integrated Diabetes Services is the worldwide leader in one-on-one Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes consulting, diabetes education and insulin management. CGM pumps

feeds.title: The Low Carb Diabetic
feeds.description: Promoting a low carb higher fat lifestyle for the safe control of weight and diabetes. The authors are all diabetics and believe in the low carb lifestyle, and minimal or no medication for the good control of diabetes.

feeds.title: The Naked Diabetic
feeds.description: The naked diabetic (author) has been living with type 1 diabetes for 49 years and provides information about living with diabetes as well as diabetic-friendly recipes and general tips on everyday life. The Naked Diabetic is here to simplify diabetes. It doesn't need to feel restrictive. Life is meant to be lived to the fullest. Let's get living!

feeds.title: Diabettech
feeds.description: Welcome to Diabettech by Tim. I'm a Type 1 Diabetic for more than 27 years. I've spent my life travelling, playing cricket, taking photos, and doing loads of things. I'm a technophile and think like an engineer, even if I don't do a job like that anymore. In this blog, I pull together both the Diabetes and the Technology to try and determine what is really the 'art of the possible'.

feeds.title: William Sansum Diabetes Research Institute
feeds.description: Learn more about what Sansum Diabetes Research Institute has been up to this quarter! This space features all the latest updates, events, research breakthroughs, and more from the William Sansum Diabetes Center, a premier Diabetes-focused healthcare center offering primary care in more than 30 specialties.

feeds.title: T1D Living | A Type 1 Diabetes Blog
feeds.description: This is a type 1 diabetes blog about living naturally and holistically with type 1 diabetes. I share low carb, gluten free, dairy free, high fat, keto, paleo, primal, diabetic diet friendly recipes, T1D living tips. I hope that by sharing what's worked for me on this blog helps you live life with type 1 diabetes more easily.

feeds.title: The Mastering Diabetes Blog
feeds.description: Find cutting-edge evidence-based information about diabetes nutrition, case studies, meal plans, and recipes. Written and reviewed by Cyrus Khambatta, Ph.D., and Robby Barbaro, MPH.

feeds.title: Dream Big, Travel Far
feeds.description: A travel blog designed specifically for Type 1 diabetics. Helping to solve any issues you may face while travelling abroad.

feeds.title: Better Diabetes Life
feeds.description: Patricia Daiker is a Registered Nurse, Board Certified Nurse Coach specializing in diabetes and a Type 1 Diabetic. She provides inspiration, motivation and practical tools for dealing with diabetes burnout and frustration. She is the author of the Better Diabetes Life 5 Step Program, a self paced video training to identify and overcome barriers to better glycemic control. Better Diabetes Life provides an informational diabetes blog so that people with diabetes can get the information that they need when they need it.

feeds.title: The Paula Carr Diabetes Trust Blog
feeds.description: The Paula Carr Diabetes Trust is an independent charitable trust supporting people in Kent & Medway living with diabetes. Paula's family have helped and supported the charity since it was set up.

feeds.title: Thriveabetes Blog
feeds.description: Thriveabetes is an annual one day conference and exhibition based in Ireland to inform, motivate and inspire people living with type 1 Diabetes.

feeds.title: Cecelia Health
feeds.description: Learn more about Cecelia Health's mission, get to know our people, and stay up-to-date on the latest company news. Follow our latest healthcare blog posts from clinicians at Cecelia Health for tips on chronic condition management. Our mission is to transform the lives of people living with diabetes and other chronic conditions.

feeds.title: The Corner Booth
feeds.description: An online brew of Coffee and Conversation about the Highs, Lows of living with diabetes, focusing on coffee and beer.

feeds.title: Juicebox Podcast and Arden's Day
feeds.description: Arden's Day is a type I diabetes caregiver blog written by author Scott Benner. Scott has been a stay-at-home dad since 2000, he is the author of the award-winning parenting memoir, 'Life Is Short, Laundry Is Eternal. Arden's Day is an honest and transparent look at life with diabetes - since 2007.

feeds.title: Small Stories
feeds.description: I'm Kerri Morrone Sparling and I was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in September of 1986. I started Six Until Me in May of 2005 because I was tired of Googling 'diabetes' and coming up with little more than a list of complications and frightening stories.

feeds.title: Learn Diabetes Symptoms
feeds.description: Get empowered with the knowledge you need to recognize potential symptoms of diabetes and take the necessary steps toward diagnosis and treatment. Whether you're concerned about yourself or a loved one, Learn Diabetes Symptoms provides a user-friendly platform to explore the different types of diabetes and their associated symptoms.

feeds.title: Diabetes Daily
feeds.description: This blog has a section for Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes. There are plenty of recipes to try,diabetic diet, The Diabetes Daily community is visited by millions each year seeking to learn how to manage their diabetes and stay motivated in order to live a better life.

feeds.title: Children's Diabetes Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Barbara Davis Center for Childhood Diabetes. It is one of the largest diabetes programs specializing in type 1 diabetes research and care in the world.

feeds.title: Pops Diabetes Blog
feeds.description: Covers diabetes employee benefits, diabetes management, glucometer guides, diabetes coaching, and diet. Pops Diabetes offers easy-to-use diabetes management systems.

feeds.title: Diabetes Advocacy Blog
feeds.description: We have been working for people living with diabetes since 2003. Our goal is to bring you together with the information and the individuals who can help you to improve your overall health with diabetes. Barb, the founder, has been active in the diabetes community for the past 22 years. As the diabetes goddess, she understands the highs and lows of living with this disease.

feeds.title: Wildly Fluctuating
feeds.description: A diabetes blog with wildly fluctuating topics ranging from humor to serious stuff to miscellaneous musings on the diabetes news of the week by a type 2 diabetes patient/expert and author of The First Year: Type 2 Diabetes.

feeds.title: Test Guess and Go
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Laddie Lindahl. I've had Type 1 Diabetes since November 1976. This blog will highlight the stories and opinions of several women whom I've grown to like and respect through our interactions in the diabetes online community.

feeds.title: MyDiabetes
feeds.description: The MyDiabetes app covers all diabetes management areas - nutrition, workouts, metrics tracking, medication logging, and education. It works for diabetes, prediabetes, high cholesterol, and high blood pressure. The app is fully personalized for you, by you. Looking for the best, most enlightening info on diabetes? Crucial info and know-how shared only here, on the MyDiabetes blog. Check the stories.

feeds.title: Well Heeled Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about foot care and diabetes alongside other foot care topics, focusing on health and well being for those that live with diabetes and foot issues. Well Heeled Ltd. is a company that cares about foot and leg comfort and especially diabetes care.

feeds.title: The Life of a Diabetic
feeds.description: The Life of a Diabetic is a diabetic blog written by Chris Stocker who has type 1 diabetes. He writes about the everyday life of living with diabetes.

feeds.title: Ellisdiabetes Blog
feeds.description: My name is Kim and I love diabetes! I've been a Family Nurse Practitioner for nearly eight years and have worked in Primary Care, Medically Assisted Weight Loss Clinics, and currently, Community Health. My desire with this blog is to be a ONE-STOP-SHOP for Diabetes Education & Management while encouraging us all to be lifetime learners!

feeds.title: RA Diabetes
feeds.description: This site explores the issues of living with two autoimmune diseases, Rheumatoid Arthritis and Type 1 Diabetes.

feeds.title: Diabetesaliciousness
feeds.description: Kelly Kunik: Spreading Diabetes Validation Through Humor; Ownership & Advocacy. Busting Diabetes Myths & Perpetuating Diabetes Realities.

feeds.title: T1D and Gluten-Free
feeds.description: Welcome to our crazy T1D and gluten-free life. Living with Type 1 Diabetes and Celiac, D-mom, marathoner, chocolate & bacon lover, writer, blogger, educator, advocate, comedian wannabe.

feeds.title: Very Light No Sugar
feeds.description: Because I talk diabetes the same way I take my coffee. Together we can foster open, honest communication about type 1 diabetes and advocate for a cure so that one day everyone can enjoy life without the constant battle of blood glucose regulation

feeds.title: Time for T Blog
feeds.description: I am mom to 2 lovely beings - my son is 24 and my daughter is 15. She was diagnosed with Diabetes T1 when she was 11, and this is a blog about my experiences mothering diabetes.

feeds.title: LADA Diabetes
feeds.description: Keep up with articles on diabetes from LADA Diabetes. Find support and motivation in LADA experiences, survivor stories, insights on medical supplies like Insulin, recommended diet, and a lot more. Blog writer Lin May is a writer and software developer living in the USA. She is writing a book about living with LADA Diabetes.

feeds.title: A Sweet Grace
feeds.description: Mothering a child with Type 1 Diabetes. This is a blog. It's not medical advice. I am not a doctor, and I do not play one on TV. I'm just a Mom who has a daughter with Type 1 Diabetes.

feeds.title: Insulea
feeds.description: My name is Lea, I'm 27 years old and I live in the beautiful north of Germany. I was diagnosed with type1 diabetes in 2011. Now it is my goal to motivate others, to accompany them and to overcome obstacles together with them, which are put in our way every day as diabetics. That's what my blog is for.

feeds.title: Diet Doctor » Diabetes
feeds.description: Dietdoctor.com gives you free and sane information about diet for diabetes and health. The author is Andreas Eenfeldt, a Swedish medical doctor and specialist in family medicine.

feeds.title: The Diabetic News
feeds.description: Delivering diabetes news and related news for diabetics and caregivers since 2001. Diabetes drug recalls, diabetic research, free subscriptions.

feeds.title: Type 1 Writes
feeds.description: Welcome to Type 1 Writes, I am Frank and this is my personal blog about life with type 1 diabetes in Australia. You can expect to find anything related to diabetes that might grab my interest here. I aim to be honest, respectful and credible at all times, sharing tips, and personal experiences.

feeds.title: The Type 1 Game
feeds.description: The Type 1 Game by Mike LeBlanc is dedicated to helping find a cure for Juvenile Diabetes one pedal stroke at a time.

feeds.title: Stick With It Sugar
feeds.description: I am a mother of three wonderful children and wife to an amazing man. All three of my kids have Type 1 diabetes. Here I babble about life with diabetes as experienced from a mom's point of view. I'm not a doctor, nurse, or diabetes educator.

feeds.title: Insulin Nation
feeds.description: Insulin Nation is a digital diabetes news platform that shares the latest information on diabetes research, insulin therapy, and living well with Type 1 diabetes. It provides in-depth reporting on diabetes news and a forum to discuss all aspects of life with Type 1 diabetes. Insulin Nation is published by Self Rx.

feeds.title: Medivizor Blog » Diabetes
feeds.description: Diabetes mellitus, prediabetes, Type 1, Type 2 diabetes Posts on Medivizor. Medivizor's mission is to improve the lives of people with serious medical conditions and those who care for them and to effectively apply software and the social web in the field of health for the betterment of humanity.

feeds.title: The Understudy Pancreas
feeds.description: Journey of a family imitating a pancreas! The Understudy Pancreas is a blog about our family life for the past nine years since our daughter's diagnosis with Type 1 Diabetes.

feeds.title: Act1 Diabetes Blog
feeds.description: The Idea of 'Act1 Diabetes' came to my mind after my parents got this disease. My father had a more serious one and for him, I was searching best glucose meters and I found a lot that confused me a lot. In this blog, I have reviewed every glucose meter with its pros, cons, and the perfect thing about it which helps the user to get the best one according to him/her.

feeds.title: Juicebox Podcast Blog
feeds.description: Arden's Day is a type I diabetes care giver blog written by author Scott Benner. He has been a stay-at-home dad since 2000, he is the author of the award winning parenting memoir, 'Life Is Short, Laundry Is Eternal'. Arden's Day is an honest and transparent look at life with diabetes

feeds.title: Diabetes Strong
feeds.description: Diabetes Strong was established in 2015 as a personal blog about Christel's experiences as a fitness enthusiast living with type one diabetes. Christel struggled to find easily accessible information about exercise and healthy nutrition with diabetes online, so she decided to create a website where she could share her own advice and invite experts from the diabetes community to contribute.

feeds.title: Yoga For Diabetes Blog
feeds.description: Type 1 Diabetic and Global Yoga Teacher of 30 years creating tools to manage Diabetes with Yoga. Rachel has started this blog to share with the Diabetes online community how yoga has helped her to manage her diabetes. Rachel's mission is to enable you to achieve total freedom while living with diabetes using yoga, breathwork, meditation, yantra, mantra, mudra, and self-knowledge.

feeds.title: Scott's Diabetes
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Scott K. Johnson. I have lived with type 1 diabetes since April of 1980. I'm a patient voice, speaker, writer, and advocate. I started writing about my life with type 1 diabetes in February of 2000. First, as a way to journal, and keep records, maybe so one day my family could look back on my struggles and successes and better understand me. I started blogging late in 2004 when tools started making it easier to self-publish. I bring an honest and open account of my life with diabetes.

feeds.title: DiaTribe
feeds.description: diaTribe is a non-profit organization providing free cutting-edge diabetes management tips from diet and exercise, to ways to avoid diabetes complications.

feeds.title: Beyond Type 1
feeds.description: Beyond Type 1 is the largest diabetes org online, funding advocacy, education and cure research. Find industry news, inspirational stories and practical help. Join the 1M+ strong community and discover what it means to #LiveBeyond a diabetes diagnosis.

feeds.title: Joslin Diabetes Center
feeds.description: At Joslin you'll find researchers, physicians, clinicians, and educators all focused on improving the lives of people with diabetes. Joslin is dedicated to ensuring people with diabetes live long, healthy lives and offers real hope and progress toward diabetes prevention and a cure for diabetes.

feeds.title: Beyond Type 1
feeds.description: Beyond Type 2 is a place for everyone impacted by Type 2 diabetes (T2D) to share their stories, get connected to the community, and find resources on topics from daily management to mental health.

feeds.title: Diabetes Australia Blog
feeds.description: Our information hub for all things diabetes related. With recipes, life-style info, and all the help you need. Diabetes ACT is the voice and support of people impacted by diabetes in Canberra. Established in 1967, we are one of Canberra's oldest charity organisations.

feeds.title: Fenfuro Blog
feeds.description: Fenfuro is an innovative and clinically tested fenugreek seed extract which lowers blood glucose level and is very much beneficial for prediabetes and Diabetes management.

feeds.title: Diabetes UK Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Diabetes UK. We are the leading UK diabetes charity that cares, connects and campaigns for people affected by and at risk of diabetes. Our vision is to build a world where diabetes can do no harm.

feeds.title: Kikisbetes
feeds.description: Diabetes Types A Blog | Experiences to Tell; Willing to Engage, Latina Diabetes Blogger. Diabetes Advocate.

feeds.title: Type 1 Diabetic Warrior
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Megan and I am a Type 1 Diabetic Warrior! I share my life with Type 1 Diabetes while trying to help others.

feeds.title: A Sweet Life - Diabetes Blog by Jessica Apple
feeds.description: ASweetLife, the diabetes magazine by people with diabetes for people with diabetes. The diabetes magazine includes diabetes blogs, Gestational diabetes, Latent autoimmune diabetes of adults (LADA), diabetic recipes & diabetes information to help you live a healthy life with diabetes.

feeds.title: Theperfectd
feeds.description: theperfectd is a blog by Christel dedicated to Diabetes and Diabetes research. Christel is the former host of diabeticfeed, the first podcast produced about diabetes and diabetes research. Here talks about related topics, new research, and her own journey living with Type 1 Diabetes.
